text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, lately we haven't 
been hearing any rumors about the 'Ghost 
in the Vocal Practice Studio'~.
choice_data_list: "The Ghost of the Vocal Lesson Studio"?

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, haven't you heard? About how 'singing 
can be heard from an empty room'!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was terrified of it for a while, 
but come to think of it, I haven't heard 
anything about it lately~ ...I wonder if 
it really was just someone's prank after 
all?

Having heard that story, I brought it up 
with Victoire Pisa as small talk.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Ghost of the Vocal Lesson 
Studio’..."
choice_data_list: Huh, do you happen to know something?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: No. Nothing about that rumor. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Friend
text_block_list.text:
Resounding with passion, a fanfare of 
throbbing hearts!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If I hug you tight!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text: Let's unleash it!

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Friend
text_block_list.text: Because I have a place to strive for!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The girl I used to practice with a lot 
recently left the Academy, saying she's 
'moving on to the next step'...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, our paths have crossed now. I 
look forward to the day we meet again.

A few days later. While we were going 
through our usual training routine...

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... sorry to bother you out of the 
blue. I'm looking for a training partner 
right now... Would you mind running with 
me if you're free?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"My. Thank you for inviting me. I would 
love to say yes, but...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think? Is it all 
right if I accept the offer to train 
together?

Asked that, I checked the training plan. 
It looked like it would need minor 
adjustments, but nothing was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
! Thank you so much...! Then let's get 
ready right away.

And so, we tried running tandem right 
away, but...

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't reach them... P-Please, let me 
try one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: One more time!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: Moo-ne more time!

I put a stop to it, thinking things had 
gone far enough. Besides, the atmosphere 
felt a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: NOT. ENOUGH. YET. AGAIN. ONE MORE TIME.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ...Then let's continue this 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: To... morrow...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If we keep running non-stop, both you 
and I will end up getting injured.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
See you tomorrow. I'll be waiting for you 
right here.
The next day.

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: One more time... Just one moo-re time...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, one more time, right!
The next day, once again.

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: One more time... Just one moo-re time...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hehe! One more time, one more time♪

And the next day as well. Victoire Pisa 
continued to accompany her in joint 
training...

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: I'm all right cow.

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for running together. Thank you 
for running so much."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I... see...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Then, "one more time" for the finish! Will 
you run with me?

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah!

—And starting from the very next day, that 
Umamusume completely stopped showing up.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...To think you would leave us so 
suddenly... I only wish I could have said 
goodbye properly.
choice_data_list: ...Pisa, can you see ghosts or something?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A sixth sense? No... I don't believe I 
have anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still, I think it'd be nice to have.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...I've heard that monsters and 
ghosts cannot pass on because of regrets 
and loneliness, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I want to stay close, listen 
to them, and help bring them back into the 
circle of others.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ? For what, exactly?

It would surely be insensitive to point it 
out. To Victoire Pisa, they too were 
unmistakably true friends.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Whenever you feel like it, 
please let me know.
